The '''business district''' was a district on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that housed many businesses. It intersected with, and in many places coincided with, the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|financial district]].
